verdict: Service in the window is significantly worse than the baseline on lateness_sec, bunching_share.

evidence: 98% of late trains were already late at 6 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Lorimer St: 180, at Bedford Av: 24, at 1 Av: 22, at 6 Av: 12. Largest time loss on segment 6 Av -> target (median +90s vs schedule).
94% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 6 Av.
61% of the run-time loss sits on one segment (6 Av -> target, median +90s): a signal timer, speed restriction, or failure on that segment.
5% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 2.7x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 27% of delays on line(s) L (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 107s on average vs 55s otherwise (2.0x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 40% of delays on line(s) L (1.1x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 19% of delays on line(s) L (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.
4% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'track' alert was active for the line (problem rate 28% with an alert vs 26% without, lift 1.1x).
3% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'rolling_stock' alert was active for the line (problem rate 28% with an alert vs 26% without, lift 1.1x).

recommendations.action: Inspect 6 Av -> target for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for L; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for L; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of 8 Av; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
recommendations.rationale: ETAs drift substantially before problem arrivals, indicating holds.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer discretionary holds; more accurate countdown clocks.
